PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: A Store screen that trades with your whole ship: buy what fits, sell all, round amounts
PluginData.Description:
Replaces the screen of the Store block with one that is quicker to trade on.
- Pick your docked ship instead of a cargo container. The plugin puts what you buy into the containers with room for it, and takes what you sell from the containers that hold it. - Round amounts with one click: 100 kg, 1 t, 10 t, 100 t, half, or all that fits. Type "2.5t" if you want something else. - Buy what fits: the most your cargo space, your money and the Store's stock allow. - Sell all of an item, or all the cargo the Store wants, with one button. - Gas offers fill your ship's tanks. - Works with Stores that sell bulk goods in 1,000 kg lots next to single units, like Octahedron's.
Store owners still manage their Store on the game's own screen, behind the Administration button.
Report bugs on GitHub: https://github.com/viktor-ferenczi/se-better-store/issues
